name: plumbing-permits
description: Diagnose NYC DOB NOW plumbing filing objections from pasted work types, initial/subsequent filing status and intended combined permits. Use when a plumbing filing is rejected, PL/SP/SD will not combine with GC, or a proposed composite permit has conflicting contractors. Get a corrected filing and permit arrangement and check whether limited plumbing alteration is a suitable route from supplied scope and cost details. Works from pasted objections and user-selected exports.
